scope: research admission, sequencing, and stop policy
directive: Do not let narrow codec, sampled-row, isolated-kernel, or benchmark-plumbing work displace experiments capable of moving the whole-model quality-storage-CPU Pareto frontier.

current_gate.experiment: authenticated whole-text-model llama.cpp TQ1_0 and TQ2_0 controls
current_gate.why_material: establishes complete artifact bytes, catastrophic-forgetting behavior, and CPU control throughput on the exact 26895998464-parameter text graph
current_gate.next: complete the exact 851-tensor text-row storage gate

a_new_scientific_lane_must_have_all: a written algebraic representation that covers every text-graph linear family
an honest projected file rate including codes scales offsets rotations retained tensors indexes headers alignment and metadata
a CPU execution algebra that does not require materializing BF16 or FP16 weights
a model-level quality recovery mechanism based on real disjoint calibration and validation activations
a single preregistered falsification gate followed by scale-up or termination rather than parameter-sweep proliferation
admission_policy_after_current_gate.pilot_minimum_scope: complete attention and MLP blocks at early middle and late depth, including every linear family and held-out block-output error
forbidden_as_standalone_next_steps: new radix packing variants without a quality-qualified whole-model consumer
new hash routing variants below complete-block scope
teacher-forced loss without free-generation capability evaluation

primary_big_bet.name: activation-metric asymmetric ternarization with structured orthogonal tri-modal shaping
primary_big_bet.whole_model_hypothesis: A shared or absorbable structured orthogonal geometry plus calibration-metric ternary relocation can make the complete Qwen3.8-27B text graph quality-viable near the base-3 storage limit while preserving a fused CPU execution path.

external_starting_point.paper: TWLA: Achieving Ternary Weights and Low-Bit Activations for LLMs via Post-Training Quantization
relevant_components: inter-layer error interaction rather than independent per-layer promotion
not_accepted_as_evidence: the upstream Qwen3-8B example requests four GPUs and is not a CPU resource receipt
the upstream save_quantized_model path writes a PyTorch state_dict rather than a packed 1.58-bit artifact
the upstream rotation factors means scales masks and mixed ternary orders require independent byte accounting
the upstream code does not provide Clark's native packed CPU graph or paired tokens-per-second evidence

falsification_gate.scope: complete blocks at layers 0 32 and 63 from the authenticated BF16 parent
falsification_gate.next_if_passed: one restartable 64-layer sequential whole-model conversion followed immediately by CUTE MATH code WikiText MMLU and paired CPU runtime
falsification_gate.next_if_rejected: terminate the family without threshold rotation-rank layer or calibration-item tuning

conditional_original_big_bet.name: shared activation-subspace correction
conditional_original_big_bet.relationship_to_clark_hash: Reuse sparse signed Johnson-Lindenstrauss geometry only to form one shared cheap activation sketch; store a low-bit layer correction whose runtime algebra is T*x plus A*(S*x).
conditional_original_big_bet.admission_condition: run only if the primary rotation and activation-metric gate leaves concentrated held-out error aligned with a low-dimensional activation subspace
conditional_original_big_bet.scope_rule: three complete representative blocks in one attempt; no sampled-row or routing sweeps
conditional_original_big_bet.novelty_boundary: Clark Hash itself is an embedding sketch and supplies no theorem that a transformer layer output is semi-losslessly preserved. Any such claim requires new model evidence and bounds.

runtime_big_bet.start_condition: a complete representation passes capability and honest-storage gates
runtime_big_bet.implementation: one native packed format and fused ternary GEMV path covering the complete runnable graph
measurements: energy and cost per generated token
runtime_big_bet.microkernel_policy: isolated kernels are permitted only to remove a profiler-proven whole-graph bottleneck and cannot promote independently

global_stop_rules: one terminal rejection closes a hypothesis family unless a new mathematical mechanism changes the preregistered prediction
no benchmark denominator may shrink after malformed output or server failure
infrastructure-invalid work remains neither zero nor scientific completion
no storage claim may use nominal payload bits while omitting auxiliary bytes
no breakthrough claim may precede a runnable whole-model artifact and paired quality-adjusted CPU evidence

supersedes.change: retain its exact text-graph scope and current queue, then impose a strict whole-model admission and one-shot stop policy on all successor research

claim_boundary: Research strategy and admission policy only; no model quality, storage, runtime, novelty, or breakthrough result.
